title: About the Authors
text: About the Authors Mary Lou Heiss and Robert J. Heiss have owned and operated Cooks Shop Here, a purveyor of fine tea and other specialty food products since 1974. Mary Lou is also the author of Green Tea and coauthor of Hot Drinks with Robert. When not traveling to source teas and other ingredients for their shop, they make their home in western Massachusetts, where Robert’s lively food radio program can be heard each week. The Heisses’s deep respect for and passionate interest in artisan food products, traditional foods, and the history and evolution of world cuisines bring a global perspective to their work. Visit www.cooksshophere.com and www.teatrekker.com
